teach.goal: Abrir a aula: objetivo e primeira hipótese.
solo: Leia o objetivo e pergunte: “Quando você precisa disso?”. Anote a resposta para retomar no fim.

paragraphs: It is Friday morning in a bookshop in Portland. Rain falls softly on the window. Bruno puts new books on a shelf. His friend Clara comes in with an umbrella. She loves adventure stories. Today there is a new novel.
